profile.name: ISITA POKAL
profile.title: Supply Chain Analyst
profile.bio: Supply Chain Analyst with 4+ years of experience in demand planning, inventory optimization, procurement, and S&OP across FMCG and IT services. Skilled in SAP MM, Oracle SCM Cloud, Power BI, Advanced Excel, and SQL to optimize supply chain operations, improve inventory visibility, and support data-driven business decisions. Experienced in collaborating with cross-functional teams to streamline processes, enhance operational efficiency, and deliver measurable business results.
